Ben / Laura — quick technical notes to seed the draft and the CSV. I captured the details below; please feel free to copy into the SIG answers.

SSO / SAML
- We support SAML 2.0 with IdP metadata exchange over HTTPS. Both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows are supported.
- Assertions include subject (email), name, groups (memberOf) and a custom claim redwood_role when requested. We sign responses with RSA-SHA256.
- Metadata can be rotated; recommended process is uploading new IdP metadata to the Console (audit logged).

SCIM
- We implement SCIM 2.0 (RFC7643/7644), support group and user endpoints.
- Attribute mapping: scim.group.displayName -> redwood_role (we provide sample CSV mapping).
- Provisioning TTL / deprovisioning: deactivation processed immediately; final account wipe/credential disable within 24 hours; artifact retention for 30 days in case of reconciliation.
- SCIM bot uses a least-privileged service account scoped to /Users and /Groups endpoints; we can provide a redacted rotation log showing automated key rollover every 90 days.

RBAC & Least Privilege
- Roles are namespaced (org->product->role). Attached RBAC matrix shows typical mappings: Viewer, Editor, Admin, InfraAdmin, Billing.
- Emergency elevation is handled via time-limited just-in-time (JIT) grants recorded in audit logs with TTL (default 8 hours) and requires 2 approvers for extensions.

MFA & Credential Management
- MFA enforced for all console logins and for interactive privileged API sessions; supported factors: TOTP (RFC6238), WebAuthn (FIDO2), SMS is allowed only for fallback for recovery flows.
- Service accounts: recommended rotation 90 days; we have automation (CloudKeyRotate) which rotates keys and writes events to our key-management audit stream. We can include a redacted log slice as evidence.

I'll attach: scim-provisioning-mapping.csv, sso-arch-diagram.png, and a redacted rotation log excerpt (to include in the PDF).

Let me know if Aurora needs the sample SAML metadata XML or a test IdP for verification — we can spin up a short-lived tenant for verification.
